dialogs.about.title: About GitWarp
dialogs.account_picker.help: Remembered for this repository. Change it later from the remote’s menu: Account…
dialogs.account_picker.intro.one: {remote} points to {host}, and you have {n} account there. Pick the one GitWarp uses to fetch, pull and push in this repository.
dialogs.account_picker.intro.other: {remote} points to {host}, and you have {n} accounts there. Pick the one GitWarp uses to fetch, pull and push in this repository.
dialogs.account_picker.title: Which account for {remote}?
dialogs.checkout.carry_hint: Carrying the changes fails when the other branch edits the same lines.
dialogs.credential.banner: The Git server asked for credentials
dialogs.credential.not_saved: The answer is passed to git and is not saved by GitWarp.
dialogs.credential.title: Authentication required
dialogs.host_key.compare_hint: Compare the fingerprint with the one published by your Git host.
dialogs.host_key.mitm_body: The key presented by {host} is different from the one trusted before. Someone may be intercepting the connection, or the server was reinstalled.
dialogs.host_key.title: SSH host key
dialogs.host_key.trust_body: The authenticity of {host} cannot be verified yet. This is the first time you connect to it.
dialogs.pr.diverged_body: {head} and {remote}/{head} each have commits the other lacks. Pull or rebase first, then create the {noun}.
dialogs.pr.exists_body: #{number} already covers {head} → {base}. Open it instead of creating a duplicate.
dialogs.pr.help_description: Filled in from the commit messages.
dialogs.pr.help_reviewers: User names on the service, for example lin-zhao.
dialogs.pr.no_base: There is no other branch of {remote} to merge {head} into.
dialogs.pr.no_push: The push could not be prepared: git is not available.
dialogs.pr.not_pushed_body: {head} will be pushed to {remote} first, then the {noun} is created.
dialogs.pr.pushed_note: The branch was pushed to {remote} first.
dialogs.pr.rate_body: {host} is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
dialogs.pr.reviewers_failed: The {noun} was created, but asking for a review failed
dialogs.pr.reviewers_placeholder: Logins, separated by commas or spaces
dialogs.pr.token_body: {login} on {host} is no longer signed in. Reconnect the account, then try again.
dialogs.pr.unpushed_body: {head} has commits that {remote} lacks. They are pushed first, then the {noun} is created.
dialogs.ref.confirm.branch: Deletes the local branch “{name}”. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.ref.confirm.branch_note: The commits stay in the repository until they are unreachable.
dialogs.ref.confirm.branch_unmerged: The branch “{name}” has commits that are not merged anywhere else. Deleting it loses them.
dialogs.ref.confirm.branch_unmerged_note: Deleting an unmerged branch is permanent.
dialogs.ref.confirm.cherry_pick_note: A conflict aborts the cherry-pick and leaves the repository as it was.
dialogs.ref.confirm.remote: Removes the remote “{name}” and its remote-tracking branches from this repository.
dialogs.ref.confirm.remote_note: The repository on the server is not touched.
dialogs.ref.confirm.revert: Creates a new commit that undoes {commit}.
dialogs.ref.confirm.revert_note: A conflict aborts the revert and leaves the repository as it was.
dialogs.ref.confirm.stash_note: The changes are gone; this cannot be undone.
dialogs.ref.confirm.tag: Deletes the tag “{name}”. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.ref.confirm.tag_note: Other clones keep their copy until it is deleted there too.
dialogs.ref.dirty.carry.one: {n} local change will come with you
dialogs.ref.dirty.carry.other: {n} local changes will come with you
dialogs.ref.dirty.carry_note: The new branch starts at the current commit, so nothing conflicts.
dialogs.ref.dirty.conflict_note: Switching to another commit rewrites files that differ from your working tree. GitWarp stops and keeps your changes if a file conflicts.
dialogs.ref.error.folder_name: Use a single folder name, without / or \
dialogs.ref.error.tag_message: An annotated tag needs a message.
dialogs.ref.fetch_after_add: Fetch branches and tags right after adding
dialogs.ref.field.name: Name
dialogs.ref.help.branch_start: Starts at {commit}. Use / to group branches, e.g. feat/…
dialogs.ref.help.move_worktree: Moves {path} next to its current folder. Git refuses a locked or main worktree.
dialogs.ref.help.rename_remote: Renaming the remote also renames its remote-tracking branches.
dialogs.ref.push_tag: Push the tag to {remote} after creating
dialogs.ref.pushed_tags_public_body: Others can fetch it right away. Deleting it later needs a separate remote delete.
dialogs.ref.reset.body: Local commits after this point become unreachable from the branch.
dialogs.ref.reset.hard_body: Staged and unstaged changes in the work tree are lost. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.ref.reset.hard_title: Hard reset to {commit} discards every local change
dialogs.ref.reset.title: Moves {branch} to {commit}
dialogs.ref.reset_mode.hard_note: Moves HEAD and discards index and work tree changes.
dialogs.ref.reset_mode.mixed_note: Moves HEAD and clears the index. The work tree keeps its files.
dialogs.ref.reset_mode.soft_note: Moves HEAD only. The index and work tree keep their changes.
dialogs.ref.switch_after_create: Switch to the new branch after creating it
dialogs.ref.tag_message_placeholder: Release notes or a short description
dialogs.ref.tag_type.annotated_note: Stores author, date and a message. Recommended for releases.
dialogs.ref.tag_type.lightweight_note: Just a name pointing at the commit.
dialogs.ref_name.bad_edges: Name cannot start with - or /, or end with /, . or .lock
dialogs.ref_name.forbidden_chars: Name contains characters Git does not allow: .. ~ ^ : ? * [ \ @{
dialogs.ref_name.spaces: Name cannot contain spaces. Use - or / instead.
dialogs.remote_url.bad: Not a Git address. Use https://host/user/repo.git or git@host:user/repo.git
dialogs.error.worktree_body: Branch {branch} is checked out in another worktree ({path}). Switch to that worktree to use it, or pick another branch.
dialogs.error.local_changes_body: Switching would overwrite files with uncommitted changes. Stash or commit them first.
dialogs.error.push_rejected_body: The remote has commits your branch does not. Pull the remote changes first, then push again.
dialogs.error.pull_diverged_body: This pull is not a fast-forward, and GitWarp only pulls fast-forward. Merge or rebase the branch, then pull again.
dialogs.merge.title: Merge branch
dialogs.merge.help.ff: Moves {head} forward when it can, otherwise creates a merge commit.
dialogs.merge.help.no_ff: Always creates a merge commit, even when the branch could fast-forward.
dialogs.merge.help.ff_only: Moves {head} forward or stops. Never creates a commit.
dialogs.merge.help.squash: Stages the combined changes without committing. Changes opens with the commit message prefilled.
dialogs.merge.unavailable_old_git: Could not check for conflicts: git {have} is older than the required {need}
dialogs.merge.clean.title: Merge can be done without conflicts
dialogs.merge.ff.title: {head} will fast-forward to {branch}
dialogs.merge.commit.title: A merge commit will be created
dialogs.merge.commit.body: {head} can fast-forward to {branch}, but No fast-forward always adds a merge commit.
dialogs.merge.uptodate.title: Nothing to merge
dialogs.merge.cannot_ff.title: {head} cannot fast-forward to {branch}
dialogs.merge.cannot_ff.body: Both branches have new commits. Pick another merge type.
dialogs.merge.conflicts.title.one: Merging will cause conflicts in {n} file
dialogs.merge.conflicts.title.other: Merging will cause conflicts in {n} files
dialogs.merge.conflicts.body: GitWarp merges what it can and opens Changes, where the conflicted files wait under Conflicts.
dialogs.merge.dirty.one: {n} local change stays in the work tree
dialogs.merge.dirty.other: {n} local changes stay in the work tree
dialogs.merge.dirty_note: Git stops before touching a file that has local changes.
dialogs.merge.toast.squashed: Squashed {branch} into the index — commit it from Changes
dialogs.merge.toast.up_to_date: {head} is already up to date with {branch}
dialogs.merge.toast.waiting: Merge of {branch} is waiting for a commit
